datasetTitle: Bengaluru Road Mobility & Safety Incident Registry (Canonical Manifest)
intendedUse: Hands-on data investigation workshop for Google AI Studio Build and BigQuery Sandbox.

sources.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) / CC-BY 4.0
sources.coverage: Bengaluru BBMP jurisdiction (East, West, South, Mahadevapura, Bommanahalli, Yelahanka)
sources.notes: Used as the schema template for canonical incident records. In Demo Mode, all numbers are strictly SYNTHETIC approximations for educational analysis.

sources.sourceName: Bengaluru Traffic Police Safety Reports (Public Notices)
sources.coverage: Key traffic corridors including Outer Ring Road, Hosur Road, Ballari Road
sources.notes: Aggregated statistical categories referenced for realistic categorization of crash types and junction blackspots.

caveats: Traffic congestion (speed/travel time) is NOT the same as road crashes. Findings reflect reported incident risk indicators, not live congestion.
Raw incident counts suffer from population, vehicle volume, and reporting bias. Dense tech corridors often have higher reporting rates.
Demo Mode dataset contains explicitly labeled synthetic records designed to test BigQuery workflows without incurring external API or billing costs.
